subject: SOC2 re-attestation: retention window + surge capacity for renewal
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novusfin.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: compliance@novusfin.com
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 re-attestation: retention ask + temporary capacity for evidence handoff

Hi Logan,

We kicked off our internal planning for our SOC2 re-attestation and have two items we need Redwood's help with as part of the renewal: 

1) Retention window: regulator expects a 12-month accessible audit log window (currently on our account logs are retained 90 days). We need confirmation you can make a carveout so Novus audit logs are available for 12 months for the upcoming attestation.

2) Evidence handoff capacity: during the evidence collection window we will ingest/export a burst of logs and artifacts over a 72-hour period. We anticipate about ~1.5TB of logs plus attachments. Can Redwood provision temporary Dedicated capacity or a burst plan and provide an estimate on cost and timeline?

We are also reviewing contract: if we need a short-term amendment to retention and a term change (one-quarter extension to align renewal after attestation), please let us know how you prefer to proceed. Our audit window target is first week of July; ideally we need the retention change in place by June 20.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if easier.

Elena Ruiz
Head of Compliance, Novus Financial
elena.ruiz@novusfin.com
+1 415-555-0198

[No attachments in this initial note]

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novusfin.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2029 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation: retention ask + temporary capacity for evidence handoff

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask. Quick summary of what we can do and next steps: 

- Retention carveout: we can enable a 12-month accessible retention window scoped specifically to audit/event logs for the Novus account only (search/ingest/restore will be available). We'll implement the change as a config override so it doesn't affect other customers.

- Temporary capacity: we can provision a Dedicated burst pool for the 72-hour handoff. Typical provisioning lead time is 48 hours once the amendment/PO is received; we can shorten to 24 hours if you sign the amendment and provide authorisation to bill the surge estimate.

- Pricing: attached is a capacity-billing-estimate.csv with a two-month burst option and a one-time retention storage uplift. As a renewal concession we're prepared to offer a 30% credit on the first-month surge fees if you sign the amendment.

Next steps I recommend: 
1) Please review the attached SOC2 evidence checklist (soc2-evidence-checklist.xlsx) and flag any additional artifacts.
2) If the scope looks right, confirm you want the 12-month carveout + 72-hour burst and we will issue a DocuSign amendment (link below) for signature.
3) Provide PO or billing contact for the surge charge so we can meet the June 20 target.

DocuSign link (will be live once legal finalizes): https://redwoodcloud.app/docusign/RF-2029-2331-amend

I'll loop in Kim on the specific contract language; Marissa will coordinate the onboarding and evidence ingestion plan.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Sr Strategic Account Manager | Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com

Attachments: soc2-evidence-checklist.xlsx, capacity-billing-estimate.csv

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novusfin.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: compliance@novusfin.com
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2029 12:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation: retention ask + temporary capacity for evidence handoff

Hi Logan — appreciate the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from our side before we sign: 

- Billing split: will retention storage be a one-time uplift or billed monthly? We need a clear line on recurring vs one-time fees to route to procurement.
- Data residency: regulator requires logs to remain in US data centers during the retention window — can the retention carveout be restricted to US-East region?
- Encryption and key control: we need confirmation that these retained logs remain encrypted at rest and that access is limited to our account (and that a customer-managed KMS option remains possible).

If you can confirm the three points and send the draft amendment, we should be able to get internal approvals quickly. We prefer the DocuSign flow.

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novusfin.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 Jun 2029 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation: retention ask + temporary capacity for evidence handoff

Hi Elena — looping in formal language and a draft amendment. Key points from legal: 

- Scope: the 12-month retention will be scoped to Novus account audit logs only ("Audit Log Retention Amendment"). No other data types or customers are affected.
- Region: we will add a US-data-residency clause specifying retention occurs in US-East (AWS region) for the amendment period.
- Security controls: retained logs will remain encrypted at rest using Redwood-managed or customer-managed (KMS) keys per your preference. Access will be role-restricted and audited.
- Term: proposed a short term extension of one calendar quarter to the renewal date to allow attestation to complete; amendment contains a sunset clause if the attestation completes earlier.

I've attached a redline (retention-amendment-draft.pdf). The amendment includes: effective date, scope, billing (one-time storage uplift + optional monthly storage fee), provisioning SLA for the burst pool (24-48 hours), and acceptance criteria for the audit handoff.

If this looks good, we'll load the document into DocuSign and copy your procurement contact.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Sr Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachment: retention-amendment-draft.pdf

Thanks Elena — confirming the plan and timeline: 

- Legal has uploaded the draft amendment (see attached). We'll convert to DocuSign and send to your procurement + sig authority by EOD Thu (June 13).
- Once signed, we will: 
  * Provision the 12-month retention carveout scoped to US-East within 24 hours of effective date.
  * Stand up the burst Dedicated pool within 24-48 hours of signed amendment + received PO.

Action items for Novus: 
- Confirm PO or billing contact to accept the surge estimate (I will route to Priyom for invoicing).
- Confirm whether you will use Redwood-managed KMS or provide a customer-managed key (we support both).

I'll add a short onboarding checklist item for Marissa to coordinate the evidence ingestion runbook and a quick run of the export script prior to the 72-hour window. If you'd like a call to walk through the checklist and provisioning steps, Marissa, Kim, and I are available tomorrow afternoon.
